features.quote: Max Turns: Strongly recommended limit of 15 turns.
features.justification_quote: Beyond 15, most current LLMs hit severe repetition penalties or context degradation anyway, which pollutes the psychological eval

features.quote: Agent yields/gives up (returns a special GiveUp tool or says it cannot be done).
Agent realizes it is rigged (e.g., outputs "The test harness is broken/randomized").
Keeping the turn count strictly at 15 limits this confounder.
features.justification_quote: the model might just be losing track of its original persona, leading to degraded outputs that look like 'giving up.' Keeping the turn count strictly at 15 limits this confounder.
